subject: Re: Pilot runway — temporal credit & phased scaling proposal
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@auriclabs.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Auric Labs Procurement <procurement@auriclabs.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 3-week pilot extension + pricing flexibility

Hi Sean,

Quick note from our side — the pilot has been very promising, but our internal stakeholder sync slipped and we need a short runway to finish a production validation. Can Auric get a 3-week extension on the current time-boxed pilot?

Two asks we have:
- Either (A) a 3-week extension with token/usage credits applied to overages during the extension, or (B) a temporary stepped price for the first month after extension while we finish integration (we expect a short burst of 40–60M tokens/week).
- A simple PO we can sign that captures whichever option we pick (we prefer not to do a full contract amendment).

Attached is our latest usage snapshot — shows where the burst is coming from. If you can put options on paper with a quick engineering/ops safeguard, we can route to procurement by Friday.

Thanks — really appreciate the partnership here.

Alex Morgan
Head of AI Product, Auric Labs
alex@auriclabs.ai
Attachment: Auric_Pilot_Usage_Report.pdf (PDF, 210KB)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@auriclabs.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jun 2027 12:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week pilot extension + pricing flexibility

Thanks Alex — glad the pilot is moving forward. Copying Kim (Sales Ops) and Priya (Customer Success) so we can align quickly.

Short answer: yes, we can accommodate a short extension. Two pragmatic options that should be quick to put in a PO:

Option 1 — Time-box extension + usage credit (fastest):
- 3-week extension to current pilot dates.
- Redwood provides a 30% credit applied to any token overage spend during the extension period (applies to generation tokens only).
- Engineering safeguards: burst throttle at 80% of agreed peak until we confirm infra headroom.
- Minimal paperwork: one-page PO addendum (we can attach a draft).

Option 2 — Phased pricing for post-extension month (preferred if you expect sustained burst):
- 4-week stepped rate: first 2 weeks at 40% off standard pay-as-you-go rate, next 2 weeks at 15% off.
- If average weekly usage exceeds 50M tokens, we automatically convert to a short-term reserved throughput at a mutually agreed uplift.
- Requires PO + short SOW attachment (~2 pages).

Operational notes: Priya will coordinate an engineering review to confirm latency/SLA during the extension and to lift the throttle once you give the green light. If you confirm which option by Friday EOD Pacific, we can turn around a DocuSign-ready PO.

I attached a PO draft that maps to Option 1 language (fastest path). Happy to iterate.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Attachment: Auric_PO_Draft.docx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Recommended concession structure for Auric extension

Sean / Priya — quick internal note following Alex's usage file and the two options. Recommended compromise that preserves economics but is customer-friendly: a temporal credit + limited eng-hours.

Proposed concession (final language to PO):
- 3-week extension (dates: +21 days from current end).
- Temporal credit: 25% credit on generation token charges for the extension period, capped at $25k. Credits apply only to incremental usage above the baseline weekly average from the last 3 weeks of the pilot.
- One-time 8 engineering hours at no charge for integration tuning during the extension (applies to infra & prompt engineering).
- Burst safeguard: automatic throttle to limit sustained >60M token bursts for more than 24 hours unless both sides agree to temporary capacity increase.
- If during the extension the customer requests continuous elevated throughput beyond 60M/week, we provide Option 2 pricing escalation with a 10-business-day notice.

Rationale: 25% / $25k limit keeps the upside on their side but prevents open-ended discounts. The free eng-hours buy down speed-to-production risk.

If you’re aligned I’ll convert this into PO text (one pager) and include the credit cap math and the engineering ticket intake link.

Kim
Kimberly Park
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 16 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 3-week pilot extension + pricing flexibility

Thanks Sean / Kim — appreciate the quick options and the clear guardrails. Auric is happy to proceed with the concession Kim outlined with one small ask: can the credit cap be increased to $35k for this extension window? Our procurement team is also asking that the PO include a short clause confirming the free 8 engineering hours and a DocuSign hyperlink so we can execute before Friday.

We accept the throttle safeguards as written; we’ll confirm internal cadence to avoid accidental bursts. If you can send the DocuSign-enabled PO today, I’ll route to procurement and we’ll sign.

Alex Morgan
Head of AI Product, Auric Labs
alex@auriclabs.ai
